exposure: Actual vaginal delivery vs. actual cesarean delivery
Intended vaginal delivery vs. intended cesarean delivery
cohort: Pregnant patients with a diagnosis of cardiomyopathy
finding: In patients with cardiomyopathies, intended vaginal delivery was not associated with a higher risk of severe maternal morbidity, blood transfusion, or readmission compared with intended cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: While intended mode of delivery did not impact outcomes, actual cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of morbidity and transfusion compared to vaginal delivery.
